Thanks for the quick intake earlier. Attaching our banking & tax forms to get ClearTrail set up as a payee in your system. Can you confirm the following so we can match invoices to POs correctly?

Thanks — quick check from PayOps. I reviewed the attached bank form and W9. Summary below:

- Routing & account provided appear consistent with a standard operating account. No immediate red flags.
- Because the account is standard (not ACH-only virtual account), we will do a micro-deposit verification (two small deposits, visible within 1-2 business days).
- Please confirm whether ClearTrail accepts micro-deposit verification or prefers a bank letter signed by the bank officer.
- For our vendor record, we need the full legal name to match the W9 (ClearTrail Systems, Inc.) and the EIN (12-3456789).

Next steps (PayOps):
1) We will queue the ACH test from our payments test environment this afternoon. If the micro-deposits land, we’ll validate and mark the vendor as ACH-capable.
2) Marissa — please hold off finalizing payment terms until we have confirmation of the micro-deposit.
3) I’m attaching our bank-proof template for ClearTrail to review if they prefer a bank letter instead: [bank-proof-template.xlsx].

If micro-deposits fail or ClearTrail requests, we’ll escalate to require an originating bank letter + bank contact.

Jonas Weber
Payments Manager, Finance
jonas_weber@redwood.com
